newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes end down, late stock data seen bearish.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes end down, late stock data seen bearish.

text.p: U.S. crudes ended Thursday on the weak side, pressured during the regular NYMEX session by profit-taking and later pushed lower on bearish inventory data gathered over the holiday week, traders said.
Cash crudes saw domestic grade differentials post slight gains, but overall the number of deals was lacking on the first day back from the new year's holiday.

American Petroleum Institute (API) inventory data showed crude and heat stocks both building by more than 2 million barrels. U.S. government numbers showed a similar result for the crude, but a 4 million barrel build for distillates.
